components.name: Finite-horizon future-safe precision and saturated actuation robustness
components.project_addition: For the E002 centered odd-width quotient and a finite integer action language, identify the exact horizon-h within-cell class count with the number of reachable action residues modulo cell width, compress the nested boundary witnesses to a scalar repair rank, prove finite stabilization to the Stage-2 gcd-safe precision, derive the one-action law min(h+1,w/gcd(w,a)), and prove that integer saturation preserves the translation divisibility criterion unless the entire clipped output range already lies in one coarse cell. Generic future-compatible quotient theory remains P023-owned; finite cyclic groups, gcd/order calculations, clipping, and automata/partition refinement are established prior mathematics and engineering.
